name: Light

targets.description: One Large or smaller object not worn or carried by someone else.

summary: An object you touch sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light 20 feet beyond for 1 hour.
text: Touch one object of Large size or smaller that no one else is wearing or carrying. For the duration it sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for a further 20 feet, in any color you like. Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. Casting the spell again ends it.
